_about: WHO International Nonproprietary Names checked by hand for the register medicines Wikidata and ChEBI did not give one for, read 2026-10-03. Sources: the WHO cumulative list of recommended INNs as republished by Fimea, ChEBI names typed INN, and, for colchicine, the British Pharmacopoeia Commission. 'no INN' means the WHO has assigned none (a salt, a mixture, a biological or a natural substance).

Aminopterin.source: Fimea (Finnish Medicines Agency) reproduction of WHO Cumulative List of INN, Recommended List 95 (17.6.2026)
Aminopterin.quote: aminopromazine ... aminopterin sodium / aminopterinum natricum ... aminoquinol (plain 'aminopterin' absent; only the sodium salt is listed)
